name: brave_llm_context
description: Retrieve Brave LLM Context: pre-extracted, relevance-scored web content for grounding AI answers. Use for current facts, research, technical questions, and RAG-style web grounding when snippets/source chunks are more useful than plain search links. This is not Brave Answers and does not generate the final answer itself.

query.description: Search query to ground with Brave LLM Context. Required. Max 400 chars / 50 words.

country.description: Two-letter country code for results. Default: US.

count.description: Maximum search results Brave should consider before extracting context. Range 1-50. Default: 20.

freshness.description: Optional freshness filter: pd=24h, pw=7d, pm=31d, py=365d. For custom ranges, use freshness_range.

freshness_range.description: Optional custom date range in YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD format. Use instead of freshness for specific date windows.

maximum_number_of_urls.description: Maximum URLs returned in context. Range 1-50. Default: 8 for this Jarvis tool.

maximum_number_of_tokens.description: Approximate maximum context tokens. Range 1024-32768. Default: 8192.

maximum_number_of_snippets.description: Maximum snippets across all URLs. Range 1-100. Default: 30.

maximum_number_of_tokens_per_url.description: Maximum tokens per URL. Range 512-8192. Default: 4096.

maximum_number_of_snippets_per_url.description: Maximum snippets per URL. Range 1-100. Default: 10.

context_threshold_mode.description: Relevance filtering mode. Use strict for precision, balanced by default, lenient for broad recall.

enable_local.description: Force local recall. Usually omit and provide location headers only for local queries.

enable_source_metadata.description: Request site_name, hostname, age, and favicon URL enrichment in sources metadata. Default: true. Thumbnails are omitted from Jarvis responses.

loc_city.description: Optional location city header for local/near-me queries.

loc_state.description: Optional state/region code header, e.g. OR or CA.

loc_state_name.description: Optional state/region name header, e.g. Oregon.

loc_country.description: Optional country code header, e.g. US.

goggles.description: Optional Brave Goggles URL or valid inline Goggles definition to customize source ranking. Do not pass ordinary search keywords here; put keywords in query.

include_raw.description: If true, include the full raw Brave response in data.raw. Default false to keep context compact.

availability.setup_hint: Set BRAVE_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
